android.title: WHAT'S NEW IN GANGS OF GADDIS
android.release_notes: Major vehicular combat update featuring new handling mechanics, audio polish, and enhanced multiplayer netcode.

items: Ambassador & Furrari handling overhaul with realistic drift physics.
Nitro boost VFX overhaul with multi-stage exhaust flare.
Machine gun audio spatialization and dynamic weapon recoil.
New Mohalla Suburbs roadside clutter, catenary powerlines, and bus stops.
PBR road plaster shader tuning for high-contrast mobile readability.
Smoother 60 FPS frame pacing on iPhone 15 Pro & OnePlus devices.
Sub-2s EOS online matchmaking session handshakes.
